title.narrative: Civil society for nature-based, local agri-food-systems (CS4FS)

description.narrative: Direct target groups: 5.000 marginalized households will directly benefit from the project (approx. 26.610 persons). The selection of the households will be based on their socio-economic status such as small holder farmers

Impact:Civil society promotes local agri-food system in Madhesh Province with nature-based solutions and policy localisationOutome:5.000 marginalized households in three municipalities in Dhanusa District have improved their food security and the civil society and local authorities promote an agri-food system with climate resilient solutions.

The project contributes to the promotion of local agri-food systems through nature-based solutions and policy localization led by civil society organizations in Madhesh Province, Nepal. The objective of the project is to improve the food security and resilience of 5000 marginalized households (~ 26.610 persons) in three municipalities of Dhanusa District. It is intended that 5000 marginalized households have transitioned towards a regenerative agriculture production at the project end, civil society actors from the agricultural sector promote and advocate regenerative agriculture at municipal and provincial level and 3 local governments support policy and programs in agriculture in line with the agro-ecological principles (municipal/provincial level).
